biography.characterFamilySituation: Parents still in Aztlan, no contact since defection. Younger sister whereabouts unknown.
biography.characterHair: Black, kept in a tight braid or under a tactical cap
biography.characterSkin: Bronze-olive, thin scar across left cheekbone
biography.description: Tall and lean with the graceful build common to elves, Maria moves with a quiet, deliberate precision that speaks of military training. Her dark eyes carry the cold focus of someone accustomed to looking through a scope. She favors dark, practical clothing with plenty of concealed holsters and always has at least two firearms within arm's reach. A faded Aztechnology corporate security tattoo on her inner wrist has been partially burned away.
biography.background: Maria Vasquez served for six years as an elite sniper in Aztechnology's corporate security division, specializing in counter-insurgency operations and high-value target elimination. When she discovered her unit was being used to silence corporate whistleblowers and their families, she went rogue, taking a cache of weapons and classified security protocols with her. Now operating in the Seattle shadows under the name 'Deadshot,' she takes jobs that keep her fed and armed while staying one step ahead of Aztechnology's retrieval teams. She is methodical, patient, and devastatingly accurate -- qualities that make her one of the most sought-after gun specialists in the sprawl.

system.description: A high-powered sniper rifle manufactured by Ares Macrotechnology. Features excellent range and stopping power, favored by military and corporate snipers.
A versatile and reliable assault rifle from FN Herstal. Popular with military and paramilitary forces across the globe.
The most popular heavy pistol in the world. Maria's trusty sidearm, always within reach.
A compact, devastating shotgun designed for close-quarters combat. The name says it all.
A heavy-duty survival knife. Last resort in close quarters.
A powerful heavy revolver with tremendous stopping power. Maria keeps it as a backup piece.
Heavy full-body armor for high-threat situations. Maria wears this when expecting serious opposition.
An advanced stealth suit with ruthenium polymer coating that adapts to surroundings. Perfect for sniper overwatch positions.
A mid-range commlink with decent processing power and firewall.
An external smartgun system that can be fitted to any weapon lacking an internal one.
A laser rangefinder for precise distance measurement. Essential for long-range shooting.
A comprehensive firearms maintenance kit. Maria is meticulous about weapon care.
A stabilizing bipod for rifles, providing recoil compensation when deployed.
Assorted spare magazines for all of Maria's firearms.
Standard full metal jacket ammunition.
Armor Piercing Discarding Sabot rounds. Designed to defeat hardened targets.
Non-lethal gel rounds for when the target needs to be taken alive.
High-explosive ammunition for maximum damage on impact.
Maria possesses exceptional aim and steady hands, making her shots more precise than most.
Maria's keen elven eyesight is even sharper than normal, allowing her to spot details at extreme distances.
system.gameEffect: +1 die to visual Perception tests and +1 to the range of any ranged weapon used.

system.description: Maria is known in certain circles as a corporate deserter. Aztechnology has made sure word got around.
Maria has a deep personal vendetta against Aztechnology. They want her back or dead.
system.gameEffect: The character will go out of their way to target Aztechnology. Aztechnology actively hunts Maria.

system.description: A well-connected arms dealer who operates out of Puyallup. Specializes in military-grade hardware smuggled across the Aztlan border.
An elderly ork woman who runs a safehouse in Puyallup. Old family friend of the Vasquez family.
A highly professional fixer who deals in high-end wetwork and extraction jobs. Strictly business.
A former UCAS military buddy. Still in active service but willing to share intel off the books.
A converted warehouse loft in Puyallup Barrens. Sparse but defensible, with multiple exits and good sightlines.
Cybereye implant providing direct targeting interface with smartgun-equipped weapons.
A specialized muscle memory enhancement that optimizes neural pathways for longarms use.
